assumptions: All sessions, decisions, errors, and minutes are invented scenario inputs.
The shared laptop and projector have a working connection on day 1 only.
The school paper pack supports the same equivalent-fractions objective and remains available as a fallback.
The scenario does not establish offline delivery or recovery of interrupted product work.
Day-4 product times record partial effort only. No comparable complete baseline task is timed.
Researcher help is included once in product setup time.
No app, LLM, Jev, provider, or actual pupil participates. Learning and procurement outcomes remain unknown.

sessions.event: In this imagined session, the connection holds. Ruth reviews each branch and corrects one unclear instruction before approval. Setup includes three minutes of researcher help.
sessions.decision: The imagined lesson is ready, but full review and setup remove the drafting advantage. Ruth keeps the paper pack ready.

sessions.event: The assigned connection failure interrupts review. Three minutes of help do not restore access. Ruth uses the paper fallback. For a synthetic 2/3 response to a 1/2 equivalence task, she selects an equal-parts check.
sessions.decision: Ruth does not approve an incompletely reviewed product lesson. A single wrong response does not establish its cause. Product recovery and preservation of work remain unverified.

sessions.event: Ruth declines another imagined product session. No evidence of preserved work or usable delivery during an outage is supplied.
sessions.decision: A ready paper lesson has priority over another uncertain preparation attempt.

sessions.event: The scenario supplies no new recovery evidence. Ruth continues with existing materials and declines the product session.
sessions.decision: Do not infer return from willingness to discuss the tool. The delivery constraint remains unresolved.

stated_preference: The reviewed example could be useful when access is reliable. The paper pack is preferable for the present device and network constraints.
week_two_reason: No completed imagined product session occurs on day 8 or day 12. The day-4 interruption leaves work preservation and dependable delivery unverified.
next_real_test: With an authorized teacher and synthetic records, interrupt an actual review on the available laptop. Inspect saved work after reconnection and verify an available lesson-delivery route. Measure complete effort against the same paper lesson.
